text:
Nina: FYI recruiters found contact info embedded in some resume PDFs after ATS import (not in visible text). Looks like PDF XMP metadata carrying emails.

Carlos: Can you drop one sanitized import payload? I want to see attachments.* fields.

Nina: Sent a redacted snippet: {candidate_id: C-xxxx, attachments: [{file_name: resume.pdf, metadata: "/Author:recruiter@ex.com"}]}

Rae: Short-term: pause auto-forwarding of attachments to interview kits until we sanitize. Long-term: add import-time sanitizer to strip XMP.

Import-bot: [alert] import-service: 12 files failed pdf-xmp scan. Report: https://internal/reports/1917654321/scan.csv

Carlos: I'll scope a small PR to run exiftool in the importer. Feature flag for private tenants. ETA tomorrow.

Nina: I'll draft recruiter guidance and schedule a 10min huddle. Also filing an incident to track legal review.

Rae: Great. Action items: Carlos PR, Nina comms + incident, Rae disable forwarding. Please post sample logs here when available. Thanks!
